kind.value: Social media project management with a calendar, Kanban boards, tasks, approvals, publishing and analytics

pricingModel.value: Per creator/editor seat, with unlimited social profiles and Social Spaces; external reviewers do not need paid seats

freeOption.value: 14-day trial; a permanent free plan is not listed

trial.value: 14 days on every tier; pricing says charges begin after the trial unless canceled

entryPaid.value: Pro $30/seat/month billed monthly, or $24/seat/month billed annually ($288/year)
entryPaid.note: Monthly rate is from the official pricing guide labeled October 2026; no checkout or billing toggle was tested.

plans.value: Monthly per seat: Pro $30, Premium $59, Premium Plus $79. Annual monthly equivalents: $24, $48, $64. All include unlimited profiles and posts
plans.note: Monthly figures are from the official pricing guide labeled October 2026; current pricing's annual figures agree.

networks.value: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads, X and Google Business Profile

api.value: Public API endpoint documentation and plan entitlement not listed in the checked integration documentation
api.note: Rella's fair-use policy mentions its API; this is not evidence that Rella lacks an API.

mcp.value: Official MCP on Premium/Premium Plus for drafting, scheduling, tasks, media and analytics
mcp.note: The connector cannot enable auto-posting; publication remains under the user's control. External assistant use does not consume Ella credits.

ai.value: Ella is not on Pro. Premium has monthly credits and optional paid overage; Premium Plus advertises unlimited usage subject to fair use

teams.value: Pro has public feedback links but no assigned approvers. Premium includes one assigned approver; Premium Plus unlimited assigned approvers and white labeling. Only creators/editors need seats
